notes: *men that* is read as the suffix's own lexical realization under rule 18 rather than as a supplied antecedent plus supplied relative; the alternative would leave both `added` and strand the suffix.
The italic *Even* is `added`: it stands before a phrase no object marker marks (rules 16 and 30).
*have* goes to the possessive לְ of the verbless clause (rule 43) and *no* to לֹא as the determiner the clause's negation has become (rule 15).
